expressions.cue: A shopping basket contains just one merchandise item. Write the item count using 点. For writing, use kanji or Arabic numerals.
expressions.explanation: 一点 contracts to いってん. Here 点 counts an item, not an examination score.

expressions.cue: A test result is six points. Write the score using 点. For writing, use kanji or Arabic numerals.
expressions.explanation: 六点 is ろくてん, not an automatic ろってん contraction. The same counter also has a merchandise-item use.

expressions.cue: A shop lists eight individual items. Write their total using 点. For writing, use kanji or Arabic numerals.
expressions.explanation: 八点 permits both はってん and はちてん. It does not establish eight different kinds.
